notes.title: ViSP Update 1.1 : performance hotfix
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback in the community hub! Please let us know if there are further issues, we will try our best to address them.

[list]
[*][b]Bugfix[/b] : Pimax users getting the wrong controllers displayed or having the interface stuck in their controllers
[*][b]Improvement[/b] : Changed the spawner behaviour to start spawning carriers as soon as any first was built, instead of waiting until the first form block was built in the direction of a monument
[*][b]Performance[/b] : Improved overall rendering performance, improved mass turret performance
[/list]

notes.title: ViSP Update 1.0 : We did it!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NqqbSgWYz5g][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32741697/0ed39988b4812f18747d1cf67fc6cf101a0644b2.jpg[/img][/url]


[b]We did it![/b] After two years of work, our VR spaceport building game ViSP is finally released with our new cinematic trailer!

[i]As a team of two Game Design students, we began working on ViSP as a university project two years ago. We made the first prototype for a three week experimental game jam using the HTC Vive and designing a VR-exclusive title. We were really happy with our early prototype as it was something really different than you commonly find on the VR games market.

Because of that we decided to try our best to develop it as our first commercially released game! We managed to win some prices with our concept and got funding to spend one year developing ViSP. It was a great time but also a time of unforeseen challenges and many overworked nights while somehow trying to finish also our university degree.

And now we finally reached our goal: Today we released ViSP on Steam, as well as our launch trailer, which was basically like a whole second project in itself and took months to complete![/i]


The ViSP - Virtual Space Port Launch version 1.0 features:

- [b]full support for HTC Vive, Oculus Rift and Windows Mixed Reality[/b]
- [b]14 implemented languages[/b] (if we do not support your prefered language and you would like to help with the translation, just feel free to contact us)
- [b]20 levels + a creative mode + a tutorial[/b]
- [b]87 achievements[/b], which bring additional challenges to the game
- [b]all our sweat, blood, love and tears from the past 2 years[/b]

In addition we provide a demo where the tutorial and the first level are playable for free, to get a better impression from ViSP.



We hope you enjoy the game and are looking forward to your feedback! 

- Sandro & Timo

notes.title: Demo Update 1.4: 16 Languages & WMR support Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32741697/2b1fc072ec6a1daf9d057f0a9e3eb5ce19b9c7d7.jpg[/img]

Another update for the demo just before we have the full title launch next week. We added a few more languages and WMR support:

[list]
[*][b]Full Windows Mixed Reality Support[/b] - we added WMR support to the free demo with correct ingame models and animations for the controller
[*][b]New Languages[/b] - Italian, Norwegian, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Vietnamese (in total we support 16 languages now)
[/list]


And as always if you have any more feedback, please leave it in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/800290/discussions/2/]ViSP Demo Feedback thread[/url] or reach out to us via [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/fmGvfKX]Discord[/url] / [url=https://twitter.com/ViSPgame]Twitter[/url].

- Sandro & Timo

notes.title: Demo Update 1.3: Oculus Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32741697/0257195040b4cbeb79e35453d09183d1181d846a.jpg[/img]

Many things happened that delayed our development process, but since a couple of months we are back on track to finalize ViSP! If everything goes according to plan, we will be able to release ViSP in February!

In the meantime, we provide to you our new demo, which features:
[list]
[*][b]Performance Optimization & Polishing[/b] - a good framerate is key for any VR title, so we put a lot of time and effort to make the best experience possible
[*][b]Full Oculus Rift Support[/b] - we implemented full Oculus Rift support by adding key features, correct controller mapping and updated ingame informations such as the tutorial
[*][b]New Languages[/b] - German, French, Macedonian, Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Swiss German, Traditional Chinese and Turkish
[*][b]Updated Menu & Credit Screen[/b] - polished the ingame menu and added the credit screen
[/list]


And as always if you have any more feedback, please leave it in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/800290/discussions/2/]ViSP Demo Feedback thread[/url] or reach out to us via [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/fmGvfKX]Discord[/url] / [url=https://twitter.com/ViSPgame]Twitter[/url].

- Sandro & Timo

notes.title: Demo Update 1.2: Visual Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32741697/49f048fd8442271e7a0671f3e44bcfefa908b1b9.jpg[/img]

We are back from Gamescom 2018 and bring you a new updated demo to play for free. In the last few weeks we worked hard on many different aspects of the release version of ViSP but also updated the free demo:

[list]
    [*][b]Visual Update[/b] - enjoy the new look with key features like the new skybox and updated shaders
    [*][b]More Freedom[/b] - play more freely and explore your possibilities with the core ViSP building mechanics in your own way
    [*][b]General Polishing[/b] - experience improved game mechanics and many small details enhancing the game feel
[/list]

And as always if you have any more feedback, please leave it in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/800290/discussions/2/]ViSP Demo Feedback thread[/url] or reach out to us via [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discordapp.com/invite/fmGvfKX]Discord[/url].

- Sandro & Timo

notes.title: Demo Update 1.1: Navigation Update
notes.content:
Thank you everybody for playing our demo and giving us feedback! :) We've read all of it and are evaluating your ideas to improve our plans for the full version of ViSP!
First of all, we implemented some navigation improvements to make the demo more accessible:

[list]
[*][b]Horizontal movement[/b] - you are now able to play in smaller spaces or while sitting down
[*][b]Improved rotation[/b] - reworked rotation gives you a more precise control and doesn't stutter
[/list]

If you have any more feedback, please leave it in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/800290/discussions/2/]ViSP Demo Feedback[/url] thread or reach out to us via [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/fmGvfKX]Discord[/url].

- Timo & Sandro
